name: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr

address.street: Khor - RabdanAl Maqta' - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This stunning waterfront resort sits on a private stretch of beach with unobstructed views of the iconic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque - one of the most photographed backdrops in the UAE.
whats_special: The Fairmont Bab Al Bahr is uniquely positioned between two UNESCO World Heritage sites - the Cultural Sites of Al Ain and the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. The hotel's infinity pool creates a mesmerizing visual effect where the water appears to blend seamlessly with the Arabian Gulf, while the traditional wind tower architecture pays homage to the region's pearl diving heritage.
pro_tip: Book a Creek Deluxe room on the upper floors for the best mosque views, especially during the golden hour when the white marble domes glow against the desert sunset. The mosque is beautifully illuminated at night and visible from your private balcony.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature dhow boat transfers to explore the mangrove channels of Khor Al Maqta, where you can spot flamingos and other wildlife. Also, time your visit during Ramadan when the nearby Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque hosts spectacular evening light displays that can be enjoyed from the hotel's beachfront.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning views of Abu Dhabi Creek
Luxury Fairmont brand experience with exceptional service standards
Multiple dining venues and extensive recreational facilities
Strategic location near Abu Dhabi's business and cultural districts
cons: Large resort scale may feel less intimate
